findings.title: Cleanup targets the literal alias instead of each created provider
findings.body: The loop creates providers with aliases `idp-alias-0` through `idp-alias-19`, but registers cleanup for `get("alias")` every time. That removes none of the created providers, leaving test data in the shared test realm and potentially affecting later tests. Register cleanup using the loop's `alias`; the same mistake also appears for the extra provider at line 425.
